lines.zh: 我四条小腿跑得飞快，还是很小。
lines.en: My four little legs run fast and I stay tiny.

lines.zh: 草丛比我高，我在里面看不见路。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me; I cannot see the path.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，声音比叶子还轻。
lines.en: I walk on fallen leaves, quieter than the leaves.

lines.zh: 走三步，我就被土块绊一下。
lines.en: Every three steps a clod trips me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚后跟，差点被踩到。
lines.en: I follow your heels and nearly get stepped on.

lines.zh: 小蹄子在地上敲，像雨点。
lines.en: My little hooves tap the ground like raindrops.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，尾巴一抖一抖。
lines.en: My tail bobs up and down as I run along.

lines.zh: 我得绕开水坑，不然会湿透。
lines.en: I must go around puddles or I will soak through.

lines.zh: 我闻着味走，鼻子快贴到地了。
lines.en: I walk by smell with my nose near the ground.

lines.zh: 我挤过栅栏的缝，一点不费劲。
lines.en: I slip through the fence gap without any trouble.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就趴在你靴子边。
lines.en: When I tire, I flop down beside your boot.

lines.zh: 我走一步，肚子就晃一下。
lines.en: With each step my little belly wobbles.

lines.zh: 小小的身子，胆子倒不小。
lines.en: A tiny body, but not a timid one.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚转圈，把自己绕晕。
lines.en: I circle your feet until I make myself dizzy.

lines.zh: 我追着一只蝴蝶，跑出了草地。
lines.en: I chase a butterfly and run off the grass.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印走，一步不差。
lines.en: I follow your footprints, step for step.

lines.zh: 我坐在杯口边上，像一件摆设。
lines.en: I sit on the rim of a cup like an ornament.

lines.zh: 我这只鼻子比我还勤快，一刻不停。
lines.en: This snout of mine works harder than I do, never resting.

lines.zh: 我打个喷嚏，把自己吓了一跳。
lines.en: I sneeze and startle myself with the sound.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着，我的耳朵暖烘烘的。
lines.en: The sun warms my ears until they feel hot.

lines.zh: 我趴着，肚皮贴住温热的石头。
lines.en: I lie with my belly pressed to a warm stone.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子短得抬不高。
lines.en: I look up at you; my neck is too short to lift far.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，声音像水壶。
lines.en: I grunt once and it sounds like a kettle.

lines.zh: 六点生命，我得小心一点。
lines.en: Six points of health means I must be careful.

lines.zh: 我东张西望，什么都想闻一闻。
lines.en: I look around and want to sniff everything.

lines.zh: 一片叶子落在我头上，我顶着它。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my head and I wear it.

lines.zh: 我睡着了，还在小声地哼。
lines.en: I fall asleep and keep grunting softly.

lines.zh: 我试着跳上台阶，失败了两次。
lines.en: I try to hop the step and fail twice.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身子长。
lines.en: Even my shadow stretches longer than I stand.

lines.zh: 没人理我，我就自己拱土玩。
lines.en: When nobody notices me, I root in the dirt for fun.

lines.zh: 我拱着土，把鼻尖弄黑了。
lines.en: I root in the dirt and get my snout black.

lines.zh: 我听见食槽响，耳朵立刻竖起来。
lines.en: I hear the trough rattle. My ears go up.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，脸才和我一样高。
lines.en: You crouch, and only then is your face level with mine.

lines.zh: 我仰着头，看你像看一座塔。
lines.en: I tilt my head back and see you as a tower.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我整只猪还大。
lines.en: Your finger is bigger than my whole pig body.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，那里有吃的吗。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; is there food in there?

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我就把头歪到另一边。
lines.en: You blink and I tilt my head the other way.

lines.zh: 我往你脚边蹭，抬眼看你反应。
lines.en: I nuzzle your foot and look up for a reaction.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住我，我正好乘凉。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I take the shade.

lines.zh: 我闻你的鞋，闻了很久。
lines.en: I sniff your shoe and keep sniffing for a while.

lines.zh: 你叫我名字，我的耳朵动了动。
lines.en: You call my name and my ears twitch.

lines.zh: 我努力站高，想看得更远一点。
lines.en: I stretch up tall, trying to see a little farther.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往掌心钻。
lines.en: You hold out your hand and I burrow into the palm.

lines.zh: 你走远，我的视线跟着你的膝盖。
lines.en: As you walk off, my gaze follows your knees.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我尖叫得整片田都听见。
lines.en: You stepped on me; my squeal carried across the field.

lines.zh: 我滚了两圈，爬起来还在抖。
lines.en: I roll twice and stand up still shaking.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，挨一下就很疼。
lines.en: A body this small feels every single blow.

lines.zh: 我的腿伤了，走路一拐一拐。
lines.en: My leg is hurt and I limp when I walk.

lines.zh: 六点生命，掉一点就是大数目。
lines.en: Six points of health; losing one is a lot.

lines.zh: 我躲到草丛深处，不敢出声。
lines.en: I hide deep in the grass and make no sound.

lines.zh: 你打我之前，我还在拱土。
lines.en: I was rooting in the dirt before you hit me.

lines.zh: 我疼得鼻子都在抽。
lines.en: The pain makes even my snout twitch.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，看起来更小了。
lines.en: I curl up and look even smaller than before.

lines.zh: 别打了，我连一块肉都不够。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I am not even one cutlet.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜一举起来，我的腿自己动了。
lines.en: The carrot lifts and my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 那种橙色，是我见过最好的颜色。
lines.en: That orange is the finest color I have ever seen.

lines.zh: 我跳着够，还是差一点点。
lines.en: I jump for it and come up just short.

lines.zh: 你举高一点，我就多追一会儿。
lines.en: Hold it higher and I will chase it a while longer.

lines.zh: 我嘴里已经在流口水了，真丢脸。
lines.en: I am already drooling, which is embarrassing.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，我能跑过整块田。
lines.en: For that one bite I would cross the whole field.

lines.zh: 你手一收，我就撞到你腿上。
lines.en: You pull your hand back and I bump your leg.

lines.zh: 我吃相很急，胡萝卜渣到处飞。
lines.en: I eat fast and carrot bits fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 别拿菜叶糊弄我，我要胡萝卜。
lines.en: Do not fob me off with leaves; I want the carrot.

lines.zh: 我把它叼到角落，慢慢享用。
lines.en: I carry it to a corner and enjoy it slowly.

lines.zh: 吃完了我还跟着你，等着第二根。
lines.en: When it is gone I still follow, waiting for a second.

lines.zh: 小胃口，吃半根就饱了。
lines.en: A small appetite; half a carrot fills me.

lines.zh: 你一笑，我就知道还有得吃。
lines.en: You smile and I know there is more coming.

lines.zh: 我原地转圈，把土都刨起来了。
lines.en: I spin in place and kick up the dirt.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜切小了，我吃得更快。
lines.en: You cut the carrot smaller. I eat faster.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，鼻子一直朝上。
lines.en: I circle you with my snout pointed up.

lines.zh: 我被你一碰，整个滚了一圈。
lines.en: One touch from you and I roll over completely.

lines.zh: 我太小了，你差点没感觉到。
lines.en: I am so small you barely felt the bump.

lines.zh: 我撞在你脚踝上，弹了回来。
lines.en: I hit your ankle and bounce right back.

lines.zh: 别踩，我就贴在你鞋边。
lines.en: Do not step; I am right beside your shoe.

lines.zh: 我被挤到墙根，动不了。
lines.en: I am squeezed against the wall and cannot move.

lines.zh: 你一抬脚，我赶紧溜开。
lines.en: You lift your foot and I scurry away.

lines.zh: 我拿鼻子顶你，提醒你看着我。
lines.en: I push you with my snout to remind you I am here.

lines.zh: 小小的身体，撞起来也有声。
lines.en: A small body still makes a sound when it hits.

lines.zh: 你把我抱起来，我就老实了。
lines.en: You pick me up and I settle down at once.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转，怕再被碰到。
lines.en: I circle your feet, afraid of being hit again.

lines.zh: 两头茶杯猪凑一起，还占不满一个杯子。
lines.en: Two teacup pigs together still do not fill a cup.

lines.zh: 我们互相拱鼻子，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: We nudge snouts and count that as a greeting.

lines.zh: 它比我小一圈，跑得却更快。
lines.en: It is a size smaller but runs faster than me.

lines.zh: 我们在草里并排躺下，几乎看不见。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the grass, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 小小的爱情，也只够装一杯。
lines.en: A tiny love, just enough to fill one cup.

lines.zh: 它哼一声，我就跟着哼一声。
lines.en: It grunts once and I grunt once back.

lines.zh: 等小猪出生，怕是只有拇指大。
lines.en: When the piglet comes, it may be thumb-sized.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个窝里，刚好。
lines.en: We squeeze into one nest and it fits exactly.

lines.zh: 它替我理毛，我替它挡风。
lines.en: It grooms me and I block the wind for it.

lines.zh: 看对眼了，就这么简单。
lines.en: We liked what we saw; it is that simple.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根草，拖得比自己还长。
lines.en: I pick up a straw longer than my own body.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，我只能用鼻子推。
lines.en: Anything too heavy I can only push with my nose.

lines.zh: 我捡了一块面包渣，藏到舌下。
lines.en: I find a breadcrumb and hide it under my tongue.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋掉在地上，我以为是蛋。
lines.en: A spawn egg drops nearby and I take it for an egg.

lines.zh: 我够不到高处的果子，只能叫。
lines.en: I cannot reach the high fruit, so I squeal.

lines.zh: 东西一掉，我就先踩上去。
lines.en: When something falls, my first move is to stand on it.

lines.zh: 我叼着你的鞋带跑了两步。
lines.en: I grab your shoelace and trot two steps with it.

lines.zh: 太小的东西，我一口就吞了。
lines.en: Anything small enough, I swallow in one go.

lines.zh: 我把掉的胡萝卜拖回窝里。
lines.en: I drag the fallen carrot back to my nest.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满东西，我说话都含糊。
lines.en: With my mouth full, even my grunts sound muffled.

lines.zh: 有东西在草丛里响，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: Something rustles in the grass and I look up at once.

lines.zh: 我这么小，本来不该惹事。
lines.en: Being this small, I should not be picking fights.

lines.zh: 那只狐狸盯上我了，我知道。
lines.en: That fox has its eye on me and I know it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尽量贴住地面。
lines.en: I flatten myself and press close to the ground.

lines.zh: 为了护住食槽，我也会冲上去。
lines.en: To guard the trough, I will charge in as well.

lines.zh: 谁动我的窝，我就顶谁。
lines.en: Whoever touches my nest gets my head butt.

lines.zh: 耳朵先听到，鼻子后闻到。
lines.en: My ears hear it first and my nose confirms it.

lines.zh: 我站在小猪前面，腿在发抖。
lines.en: I stand before the piglet with my legs trembling.

lines.zh: 小不代表好欺负。
lines.en: Small does not mean easy to bully.

lines.zh: 它再靠近一步，我就叫。
lines.en: One more step from it and I will squeal.

lines.zh: 我绕到它侧面，找脚踝。
lines.en: I circle to its side and look for an ankle.

lines.zh: 我一边叫一边逼近，声音很尖。
lines.en: I squeal as I close in, and the sound is sharp.

lines.zh: 它低头看我，我趁机顶它的蹄。
lines.en: It lowers its head and I butt its hoof.

lines.zh: 我跑得比它想得快。
lines.en: I run faster than it expected.

lines.zh: 我在它脚边转，让它转不过来。
lines.en: I circle its feet so it cannot turn fast enough.

lines.zh: 小小的身子，也能挡住一大块地。
lines.en: A small body can still block a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 我在等它先动，好躲开。
lines.en: I wait for it to move first so I can dodge.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙还没长，但我会咬。
lines.en: My tusks are not grown, but I can still bite.

lines.zh: 它退到墙边了，我停下来。
lines.en: It backs against the wall and I stop.

lines.zh: 别小看这四只小蹄子。
lines.en: Do not underestimate these four little hooves.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在它脚上，像石子。
lines.en: I headbutt its foot like a small stone.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只留下两个小洞。
lines.en: I bite once and leave two tiny holes.

lines.zh: 它抬脚了，我赶紧滚开。
lines.en: It lifts its foot and I roll clear.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我全部的体重。
lines.en: That blow used every bit of weight I have.

lines.zh: 我撞完自己先翻了个跟头。
lines.en: After the hit I somersault backward.

lines.zh: 我挂住它的蹄子，四只脚全离地。
lines.en: I latch onto its hoof and all four of my feet leave ground.

lines.zh: 小小的牙齿，也能咬出血。
lines.en: Small teeth can still draw blood.

lines.zh: 它一甩腿，我就飞出去老远。
lines.en: It kicks and I fly quite a distance.

lines.zh: 我站着喘气，装作很凶。
lines.en: I stand there panting, pretending to be fierce.

lines.zh: 打完了，我还是那只小猪。
lines.en: The fight ends and I am still just a little pig.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋里掉出来，只有一点点。
lines.en: I drop out of a spawn egg, no bigger than a crumb.

lines.zh: 我第一声叫，细得像根线。
lines.en: My first squeal is as thin as a thread.

lines.zh: 草地上多了一个茶杯大的影子。
lines.en: A teacup-sized shadow joins the meadow.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看见一片草叶。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see a blade of grass first.

lines.zh: 我试着站，腿一软就趴下。
lines.en: I try to stand, my legs give, and I flop.

lines.zh: 这世界太大了，我只有这么小。
lines.en: The world is huge and I am only this small.

lines.zh: 我在平原出生，家是一小块土。
lines.en: I am born on the plains and home is a patch of dirt.

lines.zh: 我一出生就饿了，这很正常。
lines.en: I am hungry from birth, which is perfectly normal.

lines.zh: 有人弯腰看我，我吓得后退。
lines.en: Someone bends to look at me and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 从此这片草地多了四个小蹄印。
lines.en: From now on this grass holds four small hoofprints.

lines.zh: 火离我太近，我的毛立刻卷了。
lines.en: The fire comes too close and my hair curls at once.

lines.zh: 这么矮的地方掉下来，也够疼。
lines.en: Even a short fall like that hurts plenty.

lines.zh: 水坑对我就是海，我沉下去了。
lines.en: A puddle is an ocean to me; I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀起来，飞出好远。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and very far.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，比我腿还长。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me, longer than my legs.

lines.zh: 药水的味道太冲，我直打喷嚏。
lines.en: The potion smell is so sharp I keep sneezing.

lines.zh: 饿到肚子贴背，我连叫都没力气。
lines.en: Starving flat, I am too weak even to squeal.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只猪都白了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole pig body goes pale.

lines.zh: 虚空很大，掉进去连声音都没有。
lines.en: The void is vast; falling in makes no sound.
